zh: 各台服务器互不影响，只需分别跟踪每台服务器自己“最近一次 success 之后连续错了几次”。
error 让连续计数加一，success 把它清零；计数到 3 时就换一台新服务器，记一次更换，并从 0 重新计数。
开一个长度为 n 的数组 streak；按日志顺序处理每条记录 (编号, 结果)：结果是 error 则 streak 加一，否则置 0；若 streak 等于 3，答案加一并把 streak 置 0。最后输出答案。
en: Servers do not affect each other, so you only need to track, for each server separately, how many errors it has had in a row since its last success.
An error increases the streak by one and a success resets it to zero; when the streak reaches 3, the server is replaced, which counts as one replacement, and counting restarts from 0.

Keep an array streak of length n; process the log entries (server, result) in order: on error increment streak, otherwise set it to 0; if streak equals 3, add one to the answer and reset streak to 0. Print the answer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Store the consecutive error count for each server; success resets it to zero, and an error adds one, replacing the server and resetting the count when it reaches 3.

## Correctness

The invariant is that the count equals the number of consecutive failures of the current (new) server since its most recent success. After a replacement a brand new server is in use, so the count also starts from zero. A replacement is counted exactly at the third error, so all replacements are simulated completely.

## Complexity

Time O(n+m), space O(n+m) including the input.
